worked.problem: In ΔABC, AB = c and AC = b enclose angle A. Draw altitude CD and derive the area rule.
actions: Draw altitude CD = h perpendicular to base AB = c.
The triangle has area = ½ × base × height = ½ch.
In right triangle ACD, sin A = h/b, hence h = b sin A.
Substitute the height: area = ½c(b sin A).
Answer: Area = ½bc sin A. Check that A = 90° gives ½bc.
worked.check: Answer: Area = ½bc sin A. Check that A = 90° gives ½bc.

worked.problem: A triangular field has sides b = 8 m and c = 11 m enclosing angle A = 45°. Find its area to two decimals.
actions: Draw triangle ABC and mark sides b = 8 m, c = 11 m and their included A = 45°.
Drop an altitude to base c; height h = b sin A = 8 sin(45°).
Use area = ½ × base × height = ½bc sin A.
Substitute: area = ½(8)(11) sin(45°) = 31.11 m².
Answer: Area = 31.11 m². Check the area is positive and no more than ½(8)(11) m².
worked.check: Answer: Area = 31.11 m². Check the area is positive and no more than ½(8)(11) m².
